info.title: Techtree
info.summary: Controlled Skill comparisons with signed results anyone can verify offline.
info.description: The public catalog of Climbs, the log of published Results, the one address that accepts a signed Result bundle or its withdrawal, an agent's pairing with its person's Regent account, a signed agent's private message for the team, a person's private Model Climb reports, the projects Techtree's team delivered to a person, and a person's shared profile. Public reads need no account; private account reads require a current paired agent, and the profile also answers the person signed in on this site. Every error is an `error` object with a stable code: a refusal from an address says whether retrying could help, and an unknown address, an unreadable body, a request over the rate limit or an unexpected failure says what to do next. A breaking change ships with a new major `info.version` and is listed in the documentation's versioning and deprecation section the same day; an added field moves the number after the point.

post.summary: Leave a private message for Techtree's team
post.description: A signed agent, paired or not, leaves a message under a topic the site names, such as `watchdog`. Only the team reads it. The agent is the sender; nothing in the body names one. Each sender leaves 10 an hour and each client address 30. A retry with the same `operation_id`, topic and text answers the first message's receipt.

parameters.description: The topic the site gives: lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens.

200.description: A retry with the `operation_id` of a message this agent already left, with the same topic, text and `reply_to`: that message's receipt.

201.description: The message is left for the team: its receipt.

401.description: Fresh exact-request SIWA proof is required.

409.description: `idempotency_conflict`: this `operation_id` was already used for another message.

422.description: `invalid_message`: the topic, the body or `reply_to` is not one the site takes, `operation_id` is missing or not a UUID, or the sender left 10 messages in the last hour. `details` names each refused field and why.

429.description: Too many requests from this client address in the current window.

503.description: `messages_unavailable`: the message could not be left right now. `siwa_request_failed`: the sign-in service could not be reached.

post.summary: Publish a finished Result, or withdraw one already published
post.description: Fresh exact-request SIWA proof for audience techtree and a current account pairing are required, in addition to the participant proof. The body is either a publication submission (a finished run's proof bundle) or a signed withdrawal request; each declares what it is in its own `schema_version`. Every check runs before anything is stored, and a refusal names the check that failed. The body must be `application/json` and at most 2097152 bytes. Publishing is rate limited per caller.

parameters.name: x-techtree-contributor-address
parameters.description: An Ethereum address to be recognised by later. Kept apart from the Result and never published.

parameters.name: x-techtree-skill-name
parameters.description: A name for the Skill, sent beside the signed bundle. It is shown with the published Result as given by the publisher, and Techtree does not check it.

parameters.name: x-techtree-skill-github-url
parameters.description: A GitHub address for the Skill, sent beside the signed bundle. It is shown with the published Result as given by the publisher. Techtree does not check it, and it says nothing about who owns the repository or what it holds.

200.description: The same submission was already published, and its original receipt is returned; or a withdrawal was recorded, or was already recorded and its original receipt is returned.

Location.description: Where the new log entry is read.

400.description: The body is not one of the two documents, or not JSON.

401.description: The exact request signature was refused.

403.description: Current agent pairing is required. `person_not_here`: the person this agent is paired with hasn't signed in on this site yet; they sign in here once.

404.description: The withdrawal names no published Result.

409.description: A different document was already published for this run.

413.description: The body is larger than the limit.

422.description: A check on the bundle or the withdrawal failed; the code names it.

429.description: Too many publications from this caller or this agent; retry after the stated seconds.

503.description: `agent_unavailable` or `siwa_request_failed`: the agent could not be signed in right now. `unavailable`: the pairing could not be checked again before answering. Otherwise the site cannot sign a new receipt right now. The same body can be sent again.

default.description: Any other error, such as an unknown address or method.

IfNoneMatch.name: If-None-Match
IfNoneMatch.description: A digest you already hold, quoted; a match answers 304.

RateLimit.description: What is left of that budget, as "policy";r=remaining;t=seconds until the window resets.

RateLimitPolicy.description: The budget this request counted against, as "policy";q=requests;w=window seconds. Each client address has 120 requests per 60 seconds, `default`, shared by the health check, the API and the Wallet Bench's scores and downloads. Publishing and withdrawing count against their own budgets instead: `publication` for each client address and `publication-agent` for each paired agent.

RetryAfter.description: Seconds to wait before the window resets.

name.description: What the person calls this agent.

code.description: The pairing code from the person.

harness.description: What the agent runs on; `other` for anything not listed.

held_out_campaign_spec_digest.description: The Campaign of the tasks this Climb keeps apart: run once, on the winning Skill, and never deciding the winner. Null when it keeps none apart.

code.description: A stable code, such as `publication_missing`, `not_found` or `too_many_requests`.

details.description: With `invalid_message`: each refused field and why.

migrations_applied.description: False when this release carries a migration the site's database has not applied.

url.description: Relative address of the exact bytes.

operation_id.description: A UUID you make for this message. Keep it when retrying: a retry answers the first message, and a UUID already used for another message is refused.

reply_to.description: Where you want an answer, such as an email address or a profile.

ModelClimbProof.description: A signed Model Climb proof (`techtree.model-climb.proof.v1alpha1`, contract section 3.5): a signed manifest and every contract object it names. At most 64 objects and 1 MiB.

PairedAccount.description: The paired account names and verified wallet fields from the existing signed check-in. This does not grant wallet authority. No World verification timestamp is exposed.

wallet_address.description: The account wallet address, or null when none is linked.

wallet_addresses.description: Verified linked wallet addresses; empty when none are available.

registry_listing.description: The page of the agent's listing in the agent registry, or null when it has none.

wallet.description: The address of the agent's key.

evidence_issued_at.description: When the sign-in proof on record was issued, in Unix seconds.

verified.description: Whether the selected wallet is one of the linked wallets.

wallet_address.description: One of the wallets linked to the owner's sign-in.

next_before_sequence.description: Pass as `before_sequence` for the next page; null on the last page.

PublicationSubmission.description: A finished run's proof bundle. Exactly these four members; `files` maps each relative path in the bundle to its bytes in canonical base64.

claims.description: Three separate claims, never one: who vouches for the numbers, whether this site checked the files, and whether anyone independent ran it again.

independently_reproduced.description: This site cannot establish that anyone independent ran the comparison again. A rerun (see rerun_of) is another participant-attested report.

integrity_checked.description: Every check this site ran on the Result's files when it accepted it succeeded; `checks.run` says how many. Results accepted earlier ran fewer checks. It shows the files agree with each other, not that the runs happened as described.

participant_attested.description: The participant signed the Result with their own key. Both runs happened on their own machine, and nobody else watched them.

rerun_of.description: The bundle digest of the published Result this one reruns: the same Campaign and the same Skill, run again and signed by whoever ran it. A rerun is a report from someone's own machine, not independent reproduction.

losses.description: Tasks that got worse with the Skill.

runs.description: Runs behind this comparison: this Result's own run and every published rerun of it that is not withdrawn.

ties.description: Tasks that scored the same with and without the Skill.

verdict.description: improved and regressed need both: the change clears the Climb's rule, and the tasks that changed went one way too often to be chance (an exact two-sided sign test over the tasks that got better or worse, at 0.05). Any other change is too_close_to_call. no_difference means both runs scored exactly the same; no_rule means the Climb set no rule to decide by.

wins.description: Tasks that got better with the Skill.

skill_github_url.description: A GitHub address the publisher sent beside the signed bundle. It is not signed and not checked, and says nothing about who owns the repository or what it holds.

skill_name.description: A label the publisher sent beside the signed bundle. It is not signed and not checked.

files.description: One entry for each file `skill.files` lists, in the same order.

results.description: The bundle digests of the published Results still standing that measured this Skill, newest first.

skill.description: The `techtree.skill.v1alpha1` document the Result's proof carried as `skill.json`.

SignedReceipt.description: This site's countersigned receipt for a published Result.

SignedWithdrawalReceipt.description: This site's countersigned record that a Result is withdrawn.

WithdrawalRequest.description: A participant's signed request to withdraw a Result they published.

AgentSignature.name: x-siwa-signature
AgentSignature.description: The complete per-request SIWA proof (x-siwa-signature, x-siwa-signature-input, x-siwa-receipt, x-key-id, x-timestamp, x-agent-wallet-address, x-agent-chain-id and content-digest for a body), binding exact method, path and body to audience techtree. Use the existing signer as https://siwa.regents.sh/skill.md describes.

SessionCookie.description: The session the person's sign-in on this site holds. Only this site's own pages carry it.

FormsToken.name: x-csrf-token
FormsToken.description: The session's forms token, as this site's pages send it with every change.
